case: e4_case_A (held-out real case, 5 SIDD support pairs)

stats.contradiction: channel-flat in RGB; target per-channel ratio ~1.5 and cross_channel_corr 0.445 vs 0.005 for this simulation

alternatives.why: Cross-family backup: same scalar noise magnitude as pair1 but does not reproduce the chroma/cross-channel fingerprint.

stats.pair1_verify_signals: MATCH on scalar sigma + residual autocorr only
stats.contradiction: var_slope negative; region-wise sigma not monotonic in intensity (86/93/108/167 intensity -> ~20/27/17/11-25 sigma)

alternatives.why: Low-quality alternative; included only because it passed the two scalar noise checks on pair1.

analysis.psnr_note: Noise is the only supported degradation; PSNR is not a valid criterion for a random-seed noise step. The only PSNR-mode test was the blur control on pair4: 31.75 dB, below the clean-vs-target no-degradation baseline of 32.1 dB, CI 1/10.

signal_evidence.noise_presence: All 5 pairs: direct residual std 6.3-40.9, residual high-pass sigma 3-28 vs clean 0.5-2.7; wavelet sigma 1.5-14.8 per channel (true additive sigma ~2x reported: ~3.7-23). Visually obvious chromatic grain on all flat patches.
signal_evidence.noise_type: Channel-correlated / chroma-heavy: rgb_ratio 1.46-1.82 and cross_channel_corr 0.43-0.56 in 4/5 pairs (pair2 channel-flat, ratio 1.33/1.05). Target pair1 high-pass sigma R22.9/G19.0/B28.0 matches the YCrCb:1 simulation pattern R19.2/G14.2/B22.6 (G lowest, B highest) and cross-channel coupling (0.445 vs 0.148 sim vs 0.005 RGB sim).
signal_evidence.noise_severity: Pair1 exact match at YCrCb:1 (sigma 10.75 vs 11.61, 7.4%). Pair2 near-miss 23%. Pair0 129%; pair3 278%; pair4 far below range (weaker RGB:1 already 240% too strong). True per-pair noise spans ~3.7-23 levels while the library minimum is ~12.8 (RGB) / ~21.5 (YCrCb RGB-equivalent); 3/5 pairs are below the library floor.
signal_evidence.compression: Excluded. Pairs 0-3 block_boundary 0.999-1.027 (no JPEG). Pair4 block_boundary 1.1185 and dct_zero 0.1125, but library JPEG q=25 gives bb=6.58 (489% mismatch) and q=18 gives ~33 (2858%); any real block structure would have to be a much milder in-camera JPEG, unverifiable.
signal_evidence.blur: Excluded. FFT anisotropy 0.00, spectral_slope_ratio 0.24-0.41 (<1.08); target spectrum is flatter than clean (excess HF = noise, not blur). blur_gaussian:1 on pair4: PSNR 31.75 < 32.1 baseline, CI 1/10.
signal_evidence.global: Excluded. run_full_analysis global flags are inconsistent across pairs and are reproduced by pure synthetic noise (both RGB:1 and YCrCb:1 sims trigger CONTRAST_strengthen + SATURATION). contrast_strengthen_scale:2 test: variance_ratio diff 507%, mean_shift diff 0.0151.

pair2.notes: true sigma between library severity grid points

pair4.notes: mild 8x8 blockiness (bb 1.1185) not reproducible by library JPEG

coupling_notes: Direct proof of global false positives: pure synthetic noise simulations rerun through run_full_analysis return the same CONTRAST_strengthen + SATURATION verdicts as targets 0/2/3.

§B extreme_pct ~47-53% is a formal artifact (pure i.i.d. Gaussian simulation also scores 53.2%); spatial_corr ~0.34 is likewise the i.i.d. bias of the 3x3 box metric (synthetic i.i.d. scores 0.342). Neither indicates impulse or spatially-correlated noise.
Noise attenuates block_boundary, so pairs 0-3 could hide a mild JPEG; however, even the mildest library JPEG is 6-30x too blocky for pair4, so compression cannot be parameterized in-library.

The 5 pairs do not share a single noise magnitude (true sigma ~3.7 to ~23, a 6x spread); this is consistent with real SIDD sensor noise varying with exposure/content, not with one synthetic severity applied to five clean images.
analysis.out_of_library_reason: The residual noise is i.i.d.-like at pixel scale, channel-correlated and chroma-heavy, with per-image magnitude spanning below the x_distortion noise floor (3/5 pairs) up to the middle of the YCrCb range. This matches real SIDD smartphone sensor noise better than any single x_distortion pipeline. Library JPEG is also far too strong to explain pair4's mild 8x8 structure.
analysis.recommended_action: For evaluation, use the reported YCrCb:1 as the strongest-pair (pair1) pipeline and treat it as an upper bound for the other pairs; for training, prefer per-pair noise severity (pair0 ~RGB1-equivalent, pair1 YCrCb1, pair2 between YCrCb1 and RGB1, pairs 3-4 below sev1). Do not add blur, global or JPEG steps.
